It features three floors of air-conditioned fitness studios with state-of-the-art equipment, a wide variety of classes, professional trainers, and recovery services like sports massages and a cold plunge pool. The club aims to be an inclusive community space that also includes co-working facilities and amenities like a rooftop pool.

name: Reload Sanctuary Canggu
description: is a new, large-scale luxury wellness destination opening in early 2026, combining a high-end gym, recovery spa, day club with pool, restaurant, and biohacking facilities, all designed for elite training, longevity, and community in an immersive environment, featuring advanced equipment and personalized wellness services.
